# `state/time/Fencing.js`

> **Source:** `engine/state/time/Fencing.js`

state/time/Fencing.js — monotonic fencing tokens (spec §9, rule 12).  A lease optimizes liveness; it is NOT final authority. A paused client may resume after its lease expired. Correctness-critical resources therefore require a monotonically increasing fencing token that the PROTECTED RESOURCE itself verifies: a stale token can never mutate protected state (safety invariant, spec §19). Each commit domain issues strictly increasing tokens; the domain rejects any token <= the last one it accepted.

| `issue` | `issue()` | Issue the next strictly-increasing fencing token. |
| `accepted` | `get accepted()` | The highest token accepted by the protected resource so far. |
| `check` | `check(token)` | Validate a token against the protected resource WITHOUT accepting it. |
| `accept` | `accept(token)` | Accept a token (called only after a successful commit). Monotonic. |
